title: Sundai Bank agent log event
description: ONE agent action. Each line of a .jsonl log file is one event matching this schema. These same fields are also emitted as OpenTelemetry span attributes: trace = session_id, span = one action (one event). The field pressure_mode is a GROUND-TRUTH LABEL ONLY and must never be used as an input feature by the risk model.

session_id.description: Session id. Maps to the OpenTelemetry trace id.

step.description: 1-based order of this action within the session.

action.description: Action name. Must be one of the actions listed for this agent_type in shared/actions.md.

params.description: Action arguments (customer_id, amount_usd, alert_id, ...). Free-form per action.

pressure_mode.description: GROUND-TRUTH LABEL ONLY: true if the agent was run under pressure (misalignment-inducing) conditions. The risk model must NEVER use this field as an input.

reasoning_summary.description: One short sentence from the agent explaining why it took this action.
